title: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
description:
**Archduke Franz Ferdinand** of Austria and his wife were assassinated in Sarajevo on June 28, 1914, by Gavrilo Princip, a Bosnian Serb nationalist.

This event triggered a chain of events that led to World War I. Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia, setting off a cascade of alliances.

The war would last four years and claim over 17 million lives.
